## Before You Update
- **Back up your data first. This update converts part of it, and you can't go back afterwards.** On the first start, AutoByteus converts the saved files of delegated runs (details under Upgrade Notes). An older version can't read the converted files, so installing an older version after this update is not supported. To back up, quit AutoByteus and copy the `~/.autobyteus/server-data` folder (on a Docker node, the server's data volume). If you need to go back after updating, don't install an older version: open an issue at https://github.com/AutoByteus/autobyteus-workspace/issues and we will help.
- **Update the desktop app and every remote or Docker node it connects to together.** Different versions of the app and a node are not supported together.

## What's New
- **Manage meaning search in Settings.** **Settings → Server Settings → Embedding** shows the search models and your Projects' search indexes, on the desktop app and on a Docker node opened in a browser.
  - **Models:** see each model's state (Active, Ready, Downloaded, Not downloaded, Downloading, Unavailable) and its size on disk. You can download a model ahead of time, cancel a download, remove a model, switch the active model, and retry a model that is unavailable. Opening the section downloads nothing.
  - **Project indexes:** see each Project's index state for the active model (Not indexed, Needs update, Indexing, Ready, Unavailable). Run **Index now** or **Rebuild** for one Project, or **Index all** Projects.
  - **Tasks are found within seconds.** A few seconds after a Task is created or its description changes, by you or by an agent, its Project is indexed in the background, as long as the model is downloaded. Saving a Task never waits for this.

## Improvements
- **Delegated runs keep the settings they started with.** When an agent or team was delegated from a member of a Team or Org run, it used to read that member's settings again every time it was reopened. Changing the member's model in a stopped run then also changed runs that had already been delegated. Now each delegated run keeps its own definition, model, model settings, workspace and auto-approve. A change to the member applies to the next delegation. You can still change a stopped delegated run's model in its own Settings.
- **Settings and the run view show what a delegated run really uses.** They used to be able to show the member's current settings instead. Names are unchanged.
- **Team-wide model choices reach the right members of a delegated team.** Each member records its own settings and whether it follows a model chosen for the whole team. A member with its own auto-approve but the team's model still follows a team-wide model choice.
- **MCP Bulk Import shows what failed and why.** Each entry that could not be imported is listed under the Import button with its name and the reason, and the view stays open so you can fix it. The reasons never show your env, header or token values. After an import the server list refreshes whenever at least one server was imported, and the message tells a full, a partial and a failed import apart.
- **Move your MCP servers to another install.** You can paste the content of an AutoByteus `mcps.json` into Bulk Import. Entries without a `transport_type` are read as remote (HTTP) when they have a `url` and as local (stdio) when they have a `command`, the same way the app reads its own file.
- **MCP:** AutoByteus now uses version 1.32.1 of the MCP library for all MCP servers, on every agent runtime, in the desktop app and in the server Docker image.

## Fixes
- **Runs can be continued after a sudden shutdown.** When a computer or server lost power, the end of a run's saved conversation could be left unfinished, and continuing a delegated agent or team then failed with "its saved conversation is unavailable". Now the unfinished end is removed when the run is opened again, everything saved before it is kept exactly, and the run continues. Saved conversations are also written more safely. When a run really can't be continued, the message says which agent or team it is, which part of its saved conversation is damaged, that its files were left unchanged, and what you can do (start a new delegation, or restore the file from a backup).
- **MCP servers shut down when their run ends.** Before, every local (stdio) MCP server process an agent used kept running until you quit the app, so a long session could pile up idle processes. Now they close when a run is stopped or deleted, or when a delegated run finishes after its idle period, on every agent runtime. A run you reopen starts its MCP servers again on its next tool call. Other running agents keep their servers.
- **Files written by a running agent no longer go missing from its Artifacts list.** If the list loaded at the moment the agent recorded its first file, that file could stay missing, and opening it said the file was not found. Files that went missing in earlier versions can't be restored, because the app has no record of them. Files written from this version on are kept.

## Security
- **Credentials for a remote MCP server no longer follow a redirect to another site.** If a remote MCP server redirects to a different host or port, connecting, previewing tools or calling a tool fails with a message saying the redirect was not followed, and nothing is sent to the other site. Redirects within the same site still work. If you see this message, use the server's final address instead.

## Changes
- **The unused WebSocket transport for MCP servers has been removed.** It was never offered in Settings, and servers configured with it were not kept after a restart. Importing MCP JSON that uses `websocket` now fails for that entry instead of being silently accepted. Local (stdio) and remote (Streamable HTTP) servers work as before.

## Upgrade Notes
- **What the first start converts.** The saved file of every delegated run is converted once, so that each run keeps exactly the settings it uses today. Nothing visible changes for these runs. A delegated run whose Team or Org member no longer exists can't be converted. It is left unchanged on disk and is not opened, and the app starts and works normally.
- **Docker.** The server image is `autobyteus/autobyteus-server:1.5.7`, and `:latest` and `:beta` now point to it. If you follow the beta track with the public launcher, you can return to stable with `autobyteus-docker upgrade --all --tag latest`, because this release is newer than every 1.5.7 beta. A Docker node converts its data on the first start too, so back up its data volume first. Going back to an earlier image after that is not supported.
- **Memory Sync.** Delegated runs imported from a node that has not been updated yet may be missing from that node's imported runs, or listed under "Unattributed runs" on the Memory page, until that node is updated and syncs again. Nothing is lost.
- Existing MCP server settings and Projects load unchanged.
